title: TRACERS uses speedy electrons to trace solar energy’s path to Earth
summary_en: A University of Iowa-led research team has documented how energy from the sun interacts with Earth’s magnetic field and moves closer to our planet, using detailed electron measurements. The study marks the first published results from TRACERS, the approximately $170 million NASA-funded mission and the largest external research award in university history. Energy from the sun can disrupt satellites
title_cn: TRACERS uses speedy electrons to trace solar energy’s path to Earth

title: UI seeks approval to plan for new field hockey facility, Carver-Hawkeye Arena renovation
summary_en: The University of Iowa is seeking approval from the Iowa Board of Regents to move forward with plans to construct a new field hockey operations building adjacent to Grant Field and to proceed with planning renovations to Carver-Hawkeye Arena.
title_cn: UI seeks approval to plan for new field hockey facility, Carver-Hawkeye Arena renovation
